rstar_hires_note: Research option, not the deployed model: R* with its 3D part averaged from the deployed 96^3 family and a 160^3-grid family trained for 170 epochs. In a pre-registered test it beat R* on both test sets with no extra false enhancing tumour (clean test 0.820 vs 0.805, held-out 0.816 vs 0.810, both statistically clear), mostly by finding small enhancing tumours better. One training run so far; it needs cross-validation before it can replace R*.
rstar_clean_note: Research option, not the deployed model: R* with tumour pieces under 200 voxels removed before the 500 mm3 rule. In tests on 111 patients it left the usual Dice unchanged and raised the official BraTS lesion-wise score by about 0.07, with false enhancing spots shown as tumour falling from 22 to 2 (held-out). The size was chosen on those patients; it needs cross-validation before it can replace R*.
